main.description: A guild's constitution (a Ricardian contract): human-readable prose PLUS machine-enforced rules (roles + capabilities, membership policy, proposal thresholds/quorum). Self-amending via `prev`. Written to the founder's repo. Thresholds/quorum are INTEGER PERCENTS (0-100) — never floats — so records canonicalize identically across implementations.

guild.description: Stable guild identifier (an AT-URI to the founding charter, or an app id).

prev.description: The prior charter version (amendment chain); validated against the prior charter's amendment rule.

rules.description: { genesis: [did] — the founding cohort who become the INITIAL members and hold NO durable power after (no founder role); vote: {<action>: {threshold(0-100 int), quorum(0-100 int)}} — per-action microvote bars (admit/remove/grant_mandate/recall/amend), with recall typically cheaper than granting; roles/capability bundles: {<role>: {can: [capability]}}; membership: {requireAcceptance: bool} }. Authority comes only from passed microvotes of the membership — see notes/designation-primitive.md §8.
